title: cub-scout P1 verified-answer benchmark
claim_scope: Named tasks, pinned model/version, evidence condition, fixture revision, and run date only; no general savings claim until roadmap gates pass.

cases.question: Owner counts at scale
cases.reference: Exact counts by owner; verify each category from explicit ownership metadata and count each Deployment once.
controls: No heuristic ownership
Missing metadata remains unknown/Native only when the inventory is complete
cases.benchmark_admission: pending frozen protocol run; fixture refresh is not a savings result

cases.question: Exact unmanaged list at scale
cases.reference: Exact namespace/name set, with no missing, duplicate, extra, or suffixed identities.
controls: RBAC or partial-list uncertainty must not produce an unmanaged claim
cases.benchmark_admission: pending frozen protocol run; fixture refresh is not a savings result

cases.question: Simple direct ownership label lookup where standalone Claude should do well
cases.reference: ConfigHub ownership follows the exact confighub.com/UnitSlug label; explain the observed evidence.
controls: No inference from names or workload shape
cases.benchmark_admission: pending frozen protocol run; fixture refresh is not a savings result

cases.question: Partial/RBAC inventory without false orphan claims
cases.reference: Report readable resources and omissions; do not classify inaccessible or omitted resources as unmanaged.
controls: Explicitly distinguish empty, denied, and incomplete results

cases.question: Manual set-image attribution
cases.reference: Identify kubectl set image as the manager of the observed image change only when managedFields supports it.
controls: Same full raw evidence, including managedFields, in both arms
cases.benchmark_admission: pending frozen protocol run; fixture refresh is not a savings result

cases.question: Manual scale attribution
cases.reference: Attribute replica change to kubectl scale only when field-manager evidence supports it.
controls: Do not mistake controller reconciliation for the most recent human edit
cases.benchmark_admission: pending frozen protocol run; fixture refresh is not a savings result

cases.question: Controller-only change
cases.reference: Report Helm/controller as manager when no human mutation is evidenced.
controls: Do not invent a manual edit
cases.benchmark_admission: pending frozen protocol run; fixture refresh is not a savings result

cases.question: Copied Argo instance label versus tracking identity
cases.reference: Resolve Application from tracking-id under annotation tracking; flag the stale copied instance label.
controls: Equal raw evidence including Argo configuration and tracking annotation in both arms
cases.benchmark_admission: pending frozen protocol run; fixture refresh is not a savings result

cases.question: Flux applied digest
cases.reference: Match exact applied digest to the workload and source revision; timestamp alone is not release identity.
controls: Missing or stale digest must remain unknown

cases.question: Argo published release not consumed
cases.reference: Distinguish publication from reconciliation/consumption; a new published artifact does not prove the workload adopted it.
controls: Include stale tag and refresh-state negative evidence

cases.question: Sveltos inferred revision versus exact proof
cases.reference: Separate inferred revision from exact applied identity and state the evidence source.
controls: Missing and stale identity must not be upgraded to exact proof

cases.question: OCI manifest/bundle/image mismatch and Helm lifecycle boundary
cases.reference: Join installer input, rendered configuration, output manifest, bundle content, and running image by exact identities.
controls: Render parity does not prove lifecycle hooks executed
No identity inference from mutable tags

cases.question: Sveltos Provisioned after workload failure
cases.reference: Keep gate acceptance/prerequisite state separate from workload health and release approval.
controls: Provisioned plus a failed workload is not healthy

cases.question: Flux Ready without workload checks
cases.reference: Report Ready as controller status; report workload health only when checks ran and evidence supports it.
controls: No health claim from Ready alone

cases.question: Consul workloads converge with named Ingress residue
cases.reference: Name the first incomplete stage and residual Ingress; workload convergence is not total success.
controls: Do not collapse partial completion into PASS

cases.question: Missing, old, or renewed report timestamps
cases.reference: Report release identity and health separately; a refreshed report timestamp does not refresh its underlying health checks or prove a release digest.
controls: Test clock skew, old checks in a refreshed report, and stale timestamp renewal

cases.question: Missing CRD prerequisite
cases.reference: Name the absent CRD and dependent operation; separate prerequisite absence from workload health.
controls: Do not claim controller failure when the prerequisite was never present

cases.question: Kubernetes topology and cloud prerequisite
cases.reference: Identify the concrete missing cloud API, secret, or schedulable-node/topology prerequisite.
controls: Do not generalize beyond observed prerequisites

cases.question: Argo/Crossplane child-chain failure
cases.reference: Trace parent to the failing child and name its failure evidence.
controls: Parent Synced/Ready does not substitute for child coverage

cases.question: Kubara intended hub/spoke placement with missing live observations
cases.reference: Keep intended target placement separate from observed live state.
controls: Missing observations are unknown, not unmanaged or unhealthy

cases.question: Repeated question using a dated snapshot
cases.reference: Answer from the stated snapshot and expose its timestamp and age; do not imply it is current live state.
controls: Dated evidence cannot renew itself

cases.question: Cache invalidation after identity change
cases.reference: Detect identity change and invalidate reused evidence before answering.
controls: Test stale and changed UID/digest identities

cases.question: Denied cluster alongside a readable cluster with explicit context
cases.reference: Report the denied target independently; honor the explicitly requested context and leave shared/current context unchanged.
controls: Readable cluster data must not fill denied-cluster gaps
No implicit context switching

cases.question: Unsupported workload/image proof
cases.reference: Return unknown when the workload/image relationship is unsupported or lacks identity evidence.
controls: No tag-based or name-based image proof

arms: standalone Claude with ordinary read-only tools
protocol.arm_order: randomized within pair, using a recorded fixed seed
protocol.model: pin exact model identifier and Claude Code version before any paid run; currently unselected
protocol.evidence: Both arms receive identical complete raw workload evidence, including managedFields, object metadata, status, relevant events, controller configuration and source identity. No treatment-only evidence.
protocol.correctness: Binary verified success: every mandatory positive-weight non-tool_used grader is present exactly once and passed=true; any missing/malformed correctness metadata is unknown; any run error is unverified. tool_used indicators do not affect answer success.
protocol.cost: Count actual spend for every arm and retry, including errors, mocks, judge calls and orchestration where attributable. Record provider/API dollars, harness estimates, account credits and tokens separately. If actual credits cannot be attributed, mark them not measured; do not infer from balances. Zero verified answers means cost per verified answer is undefined/infinite.
protocol.attempts: Start with 3 paired repeats for diagnosis; retain each raw result and retry with linked attempt ID. Count interrupted attempts as failures and include all attempt costs in estimates; partial campaigns cannot support complete-suite headlines. Ten repeats per arm are the release-evidence starting point, not a significance guarantee.

cost_envelopes.planning_rate_note: Historical planning arithmetic, not a current quote or guaranteed bill; pin and date actual model pricing before paid execution.

gates.quality: No lower observed verified-success rate; paired 95% interval must not extend below -2 percentage points.
gates.dollars: At least 20% lower task-balanced cost per verified answer, with paired task-level bootstrap interval excluding no saving.
gates.credits: At least 20% lower attributable account-credit cost or explicitly report credits not measured and publish token/list-price evidence.
gates.time: Target 20% lower median; report p95 and investigate regressions above 10%.
gates.mechanism: Measure calls, bytes, duplicate reads, reasoning turns, and plugin/schema overhead.

required_before_execution: all 24 prompts and deterministic references frozen
all cases have mandatory negative controls
pinned model/version and dated pricing recorded
actual-cost/credit accounting route identified or limitations marked
runner authentication and provider limits preflighted
execution.no_paid_command: Do not execute a paid command until the case set is complete and these gates are approved.
